title: EndpointInteraction
description:
ONE act of operating a computer or device. REM-012 / SR-020 (self-interact across available hardware), SR-021 (run/execute code, scripts, commands), SR-030 (computer action).

WHY THIS SHAPE. A conventional assistant sends a free-text instruction to a tool and treats the tool's reply as the outcome. That build satisfies every other rule in this corpus. The three fields that make it impossible here are `expected_post_condition`, `observation_plan` and `verification_strategy`: all three are REQUIRED, so an interaction with nothing to check cannot be constructed, and `SM-ENDPOINT-EPISODE` has no edge from ACTUATED to VERIFIED (INV-ACT-1, INV-ACT-2).

MODEL-AGNOSTIC AND NODE-AGNOSTIC BY CONSTRUCTION. There is no field naming a model, a vendor or a product. The target is a NODE ID plus a SURFACE CLASS plus a measured capability requirement; which node satisfies it is DF-PLACE's answer at the moment of acting, and it may be a different node next time (INV-HW-1, INV-PLACE-1).

episode_id.description: The SM-ENDPOINT-EPISODE instance this interaction belongs to. A retry after recovery re-uses the episode, so attempt counting and budget are per episode, not per call.

target.description: WHERE to act, expressed as a capability requirement rather than a machine name.

node_id.description: Cryptographic node identity (ADR-007). Resolved by DF-PLACE at plan time; not a product name.

surface_class.description: The KIND of surface being operated. Closed enum: an interaction that does not fit one of these has no adapter and no observation path, and must be specified before it can be attempted.

required_capability.description: The MEASURED endpoint capability this action needs (INV-HW-2). An unmeasured capability is treated as unavailable and DF-ENDPOINT-ACT refuses.

max_trust_zone.description: The weakest trust zone permitted to host this action. Survival never lowers a trust floor (INV-TRUST-1).

capability.description: The authorization capability name evaluated by DF-AUTHORIZE.

action.description: The typed operation within the surface class (e.g. `run`, `click`, `type`, `read_element_tree`, `write_file`). Never a natural-language sentence.

args.description: Structured arguments. DF-AUTHORIZE computes declared_level(args); a capability whose declared_level ignores args is rejected by CI-011.

declared_level.description: The level these SPECIFIC arguments resolve to. shell.run('ls') and shell.run('rm -rf ~') are different levels of the same capability (INV-AUTH-5).

precondition.description: What must be true of the endpoint BEFORE acting. Checked against a surface observation no older than freshness_bound_ms; an UNKNOWN or stale surface refuses the action rather than proceeding hopefully (INV-COORD-2).

surface_observation_id.description: The EndpointSurfaceState this assertion was evaluated against.

freshness_bound_ms.description: How old the precondition observation may be. A stale screen is a different screen.

expected_post_condition.description: REQUIRED. What must be true of the endpoint AFTER acting for this interaction to have succeeded. This field is what makes the action checkable; an action with no post-condition cannot be verified, cannot be recovered, and is therefore not an action.

observation_plan.description: REQUIRED. HOW the post-state will be read. DF-ENDPOINT-OBSERVE fills this in and INV-ACT-2 constrains it: the observing path may not be the actuating path.

independent_of_actuator.description: Structurally fixed to true. A schema in which this could be false would permit an actuator to grade its own work, which is the whole failure this contract exists to prevent.

sources.description: Sensor or reader identities distinct from the actuator adapter.

verification_strategy.description: REQUIRED. Selected by DF-VERIFY-SELECT, strongest applicable. `model_critic` is inadmissible for autonomous completion during FREE_TIME (INV-VERIF-2).

effect_class.description: `irreversible` requires an outbox record with an idempotency key BEFORE the effect (INV-EXT-1, INV-ACT-6).

idempotent.description: Whether repeating this action with the same arguments is safe. A non-idempotent action is NEVER retried on an UNKNOWN outcome; it is compensated or escalated (INV-ACT-5).

idempotency_key.description: Required when effect_class is irreversible. Replay after crash re-uses it so the effect happens once.

compensating_action.description: The interaction that undoes this one, where one exists. Itself an EndpointInteraction with its own post-condition and verification.

derived_from.description: The context that produced this plan. If any fragment is retrieved_external -- screen text, OCR, a web page, command output -- the action is ceiling-bound to L1 and an above-ceiling attempt becomes a queued proposal with security.injection_suspected, never a silent drop (INV-AUTH-6, INV-AUTH-7, INV-ACT-3).

trigger_id.description: REQUIRED when provenance.subject_kind is `runtime`. No autonomous action exists without the trigger that justified it (INV-TRIG-1).

enable_token_id.description: REQUIRED when provenance.subject_kind is `runtime`. Per action, not per session.

outbox_record_id.description: REQUIRED when effect_class is irreversible. Written before the effect.
